info.title: Add i686 Windows GNU import libs to Cargo.toml

diffs.patch:
Index: Cargo.toml
===================================================================
--- Cargo.toml	
+++ Cargo.toml	
@@ -1,7 +1,33 @@
 [package]
 name = "demo"
 version = "0.1.0"
 edition = "2021"
 
 [dependencies]
-serde = { version = "=1.0.195", features = ["derive"] }
\ No newline at end of file
+serde = { version = "=1.0.195", features = ["derive"] }
+
+[target.i686-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]
+winapi = { version = "0.3", features = [
+    "winnt",
+    "minwindef",
+    "windef",
+    "winbase",
+    "winuser",
+    "winerror",
+    "handleapi",
+    "errhandlingapi",
+    "libloaderapi",
+    "memoryapi",
+    "processthreadsapi",
+    "synchapi",
+    "fileapi",
+    "winreg",
+    "shell32",
+    "shlobj",
+    "gdi32",
+    "advapi32",
+    "ole32",
+    "oleaut32",
+    "winsock2",
+    "ws2tcpip",
+] }
\ No newline at end of file

parts.text: "This Rust project is cross-compiled for the 32-bit Windows GNU toolchain (i686-pc-windows-gnu). Add the platform-specific import libraries it needs for Windows API bindings on that target to Cargo.toml."
Let me look at the project structure first.
